description: A React component plugin for the Lexical editor that enforces a maximum indentation level for list items by intercepting indentation commands.

methods.name: getElementNodesInSelection
methods.description: Retrieves all element nodes within the current selection, including handling cases where the selection is empty by using the anchor and focus nodes.

methods.name: isIndentPermitted
methods.description: Determines whether indentation is allowed based on the current selection's list depth relative to the maximum allowed depth.
